title: Hybrid-time PINNs: Discontinuity-Aware Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Learning Hybrid Dynamical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.33562v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hybrid dynamical systems flow continuously but jump at discrete events. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) fit data while enforcing known dynamics, but a single network is smooth in time and cannot model these jumps. We show that the more closely a PINN follows a jump, the larger its physics loss must be. We propose hybrid-time PINNs (HT-PINNs), which assign one network to each flow interval of the hybrid time domain and train the networks jointly with the jump times and the unknown parameters. The number of jumps and the sequence of modes are found by enumeration. HT-PINNs recover the number of jumps and the restitution coefficient of a bouncing ball. In a MuJoCo simulation of robotic disassembly, where a robot pulls a press-fitted pin out of a housing through a spring, HT-PINNs find the number of jumps and the sequence of modes, and estimate the static and kinetic friction coefficients with small errors of 0.1% and 1.7%.

translated_title: 混合时间PINNs：面向混合动态系统学习的具有不连续性感知能力的物理信息神经网络
translated_abstract: 混合动态系统连续演化，但在离散事件处发生跳变。物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在拟合数据的同时施加已知动力学约束，但单个网络在时间上是平滑的，无法对这些跳变进行建模。我们证明，PINN对跳变跟随得越精确，其物理损失就必须越大。为此，我们提出混合时间PINNs（HT-PINNs），为混合时间域的每个连续流区间分配一个网络，并将这些网络与跳变时刻和未知参数进行联合训练。跳变的数量和模态序列通过枚举方法确定。HT-PINNs成功恢复了弹跳球的跳变次数和恢复系数。在一个MuJoCo机器人拆解仿真中——机器人通过弹簧将过盈配合的销从壳体中拉出——HT-PINNs找到了跳变次数和模态序列，并以0.1%和1.7%的小误差分别估计出静摩擦系数和动摩擦系数。
tldr: 提出混合时间PINNs（HT-PINNs），为混合时间域的每个连续流区间分配独立网络并与跳变时刻、未知参数联合训练，突破了单个平滑网络无法建模跳变的限制，能够自动恢复跳变次数、模态序列并准确估计摩擦系数等物理参数。
en_tdlr: HT-PINNs assign one network to each flow interval of the hybrid time domain and train them jointly with jump times and unknown parameters, overcoming the limitation that a single smooth network cannot model jumps, thereby enabling accurate learning of hybrid dynamical systems including the number of jumps, mode sequences, and physical parameters such as friction coefficients.
